page_title: BET 2-3 VIL | Betis v Villarreal 10/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's it for today, Alejandro Hernandez has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+9' Marc Roca (Betis) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Villarreal.
90+9' Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul after Sokratis Papastathopoulos (Betis) hacks down one of his opponents.
90+5' Nabil Fekir (Betis) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Filip Jorgensen has no trouble gathering it.
90+4' Ayoze Perez (Betis) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
90+1' Johnny (Betis) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
90+1' Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle and it's Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
90' Marcelino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yerson Mosquera (Villarreal) replacing Kiko.
88' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Juan Miranda will be replaced by Pablo Busto Gonzalez (Betis).
88' The substitution is prepared. Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Youssouf Sabaly.
85' Nabil Fekir (Betis) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
83' Nabil Fekir (Betis) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
81' A substitution has been made. Santi Comesana is replaced by Etienne Capoue (Villarreal).
80' Nabil Fekir (Betis) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
80' Betis take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
79' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Ayoze Perez (Betis), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Good work from Betis as they win a corner.
78' Filip Jorgensen (Villarreal) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Marc Roca (Betis) is coming onto the pitch as Guido Rodriguez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
78' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to substitute William Carvalho and he is replaced by Johnny (Betis).
74' Substitution. Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) on for Bertrand Traore.
74' Here is a change. Alex Baena is going off and Marcelino gives the last tactical orders to Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal).
74' The manager makes a subsitution with Francis Coquelin (Villarreal) coming on for Gerard Moreno.
73' Willian Jose (Betis) blows a big chance to score! He slammed the ball from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it went narrowly over the crossbar.
70' Chimy Avila (Betis) receives a yellow card! It's his second one today, which means he will be send off!
70' A second caution from Alejandro Hernandez for Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) means that he has to leave the pitch early today. It's a red card.
69' Caution goes to Alberto Moreno (Villarreal).
69' Chimy Avila (Betis) receives a yellow card for infringement.
67' Substitution. Ayoze Perez (Betis) has come on for Pablo Fornals.
67' 2 - 3 Goal! A great through ball by Gerard Moreno sets up Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the bottom right corner. 2:3.
67' Nabil Fekir (Betis) is obviously very disappointed with his shot from the rebound. He aims exactly at the goalkeeper's gloves. This should have been an easy goal!
66' Chimy Avila (Betis) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Filip Jorgensen stops the ball out of the bottom right corner.
64' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) jumps into a tackle and Alejandro Hernandez signals a foul.
61' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Chimy Avila (Betis) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
60' The corner is swung in but Betis can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

60' Chimy Avila (Betis) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Chimy Avila (Betis) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. Betis have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
56' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
56' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Rui Silva is alert and denies him with a nice save.
52' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Nabil Fekir (Betis), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
51' Kiko (Villarreal) tackles a bit over-zealously and Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul.
48' 2 - 2 It's an own goal! An unlucky moment for Sokratis (Betis), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but heads the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 2:2.
48' The attendance for today's match is 47711.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
45+4' Referee Alejandro Hernandez points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Betis players.
45+4' Wait! The referee has now indicated he wants to check if the goal for Betis can stand using VAR.
45+2' 2 - 1 Goal! Pablo Fornals puts a cross into the box and finds Willian Jose (Betis), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the middle of the net. He makes it 2:1.
45+1' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Willian Jose (Betis).
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' The referee blows his whistle as Santi Comesana (Villarreal) was too aggressive in his challenge. Betis are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
43' Pablo Fornals (Betis) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
40' 1 - 1 Goal! Alex Baena (Villarreal) scores after an assist by Alexander Sorloth that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 1:1.
39' Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle after Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
37' Pablo Fornals (Betis) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
36' Juan Miranda (Betis) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Betis have a corner.
36' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul.
34' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) receives a clever chip pass into a promising position. Nevertheless, one of the defenders is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.

30' 1 - 0 What a goal! William Carvalho plays it to Guido Rodriguez (Betis), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Filip Jorgensen into the left side of the goal. 1:0.
30' Pablo Fornals (Betis) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
29' Bertrand Traore (Villarreal) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
27' Nabil Fekir (Betis) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
26' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the bottom left corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
26' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
24' Alex Baena (Villarreal) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
22' Alex Baena (Villarreal) is caught offside!

19' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Villarreal are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
16' Poor challenge! Santi Comesana (Villarreal) is penalised for tripping and Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle.
15' Betis seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
12' A pass by Chimy Avila (Betis) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

11' William Carvalho (Betis) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
9' Juan Miranda (Betis) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
7' Pablo Fornals (Betis) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
7' A cross into the box from Alex Baena (Villarreal) is cleared.
6' The resulting set piece from Betis is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
6' Nabil Fekir (Betis) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
5' Willian Jose (Betis) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The linesman points to the corner flag, Betis are going to take it.
2' Alex Baena (Villarreal) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Villarreal will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Alejandro Hernandez.
